angle_gap: AIHR's page defines the Training Facilitator role for internal HR use (job family, salary range, responsibilities, job-description template) but gives a recruiter nothing to screen candidates with — no interview questions, no skills to test for, no way to tell a strong facilitator from someone who just presents well.
asset: Hiring a Training Facilitator: The Skills That Predict Delivery, Not Just Presentation
distinct_angle: Keeps AIHR's role-guide shape but rebuilds it from the hiring side — adding the interview questions, facilitation-skill assessment criteria, and screening red flags AIHR's internal job-description version never touches.
